response: AmazonHistoryPrice reports that Phi-2 is an unaligned model with very poor baseline bargaining performance as Buyer (deal rate 13.64%), but OG-Narrator dramatically raises its deal rate to 88.08% and enables the unaligned model to bargain effectively. EAI reports that OpenChat-7b, described as an unaligned uncensored model, has notably high acceptance rates in bargaining in both English and Russian, whereas strongly RLHF-aligned LLaMA-2 70b shows markedly lower acceptance rates and a stricter threshold for accepting offers. Thus, AmazonHistoryPrice shows OG-Narrator converting an unaligned low-performing model into a strong bargaining agent, while EAI shows OpenChat-7b already exhibiting a high propensity to cooperate/accept offers relative to strongly aligned models like LLaMA-2.
judge_justification: The response correctly compares the two studies: it notes that Phi-2 performs poorly in AmazonHistoryPrice at baseline but improves dramatically with OG-Narrator, and that OpenChat-7b in EAI shows high acceptance/cooperation relative to strongly RLHF-aligned models like LLaMA-2. This captures the key synthesis that both unaligned/uncensored models can be more cooperative, though under different experimental conditions and with different baseline performance.
